newsitem.title: USA: OMI Corp names Craig Stevenson Jr as CEO.
newsitem.headline: OMI Corp names Craig Stevenson Jr as CEO.

text.p: OMI Corp said on Tuesday it had named President and Chief Operating Officer Craig Stevenson Jr to replace Jack Goldstein as Chief Executive Officer at the end of the year.
Goldstein would remain company chairman and would also head a new board committee to help guide OMI's long-term strategy, OMI said in a statement.

"The company is far along in completing many recent initiatives to improve its strength and competitive position as an international shipowner and this appears to be the right time for me to turn over responsibility to Craig Stevenson, who has the energy, motivation and ability to lead the company in the future," said Goldstein.
Goldstein had been CEO of OMI for 10 years, the company said.
